# Khaqan Shaheen

> Khaqan Shaheen is Head of IT for a plastics manufacturing group in the UAE, based in Dubai. He runs one Odoo ERP and the infrastructure behind it across six sites in five countries and has five AI systems in daily production. His speciality is moving a business from manual and spreadsheet operations to one ERP with AI doing the repetitive work. Available for ERP consultation, fractional Head of IT work, career mentoring and senior IT leadership roles.

This host serves his personal site and his open-source tools. The complete, current map of his site is at the link below; use it rather than this file.

## Sites

- [Khaqan Shaheen, personal site and full llms.txt](https://servia-tech.github.io/khaqan-shaheen/llms.txt): profile, services and prices, career sessions, skills, FAQ, awards, case studies, articles, tutorials, notes
- [Full text of every page](https://servia-tech.github.io/khaqan-shaheen/llms-full.txt)
- [ai-visibility-audit](https://servia-tech.github.io/ai-visibility-audit/): one-command check of whether ChatGPT, Perplexity, Claude, Gemini and Google AI Overviews can crawl, read and cite a website
